description: Form-level conditional visibility — the THIRD Criteria owner family (beyond page Container Criteria and FieldValidation Criteria): ColumnVisibility. Target column carries a static IsHidden:true plus a ColumnVisibility::Criteria whose Condition, when true, reveals the field. Captured live off a copilot build 2026-08-12 (#48, cell 3). Graph-verified; RUNTIME semantics unverified (no live item walk yet).
notes: Three differences vs the two known Criteria families: (1) HasArguments:false (every FieldValidation Condition captured has it true); (2) the trigger reference is LHSOwnField pointing at the trigger's COLUMN id — not a Field id, not a page LHSVariable dot-path; (3) IsOR sits on the Criteria — an AND/OR combination lever a single-condition capture cannot fully characterize.

Mechanism as captured: target column hidden by default (static IsHidden:true); the Criteria's Condition true => field revealed. Runtime toggle behavior UNVERIFIED — the graph diff proves the shape, not the behavior (THE RULE).
Back-ref is bidirectional: the trigger column carries LHSOwnField::Condition listing the Condition node.

A sibling fourth family for conditional REQUIRED (ColumnRequired or similar) plausibly exists — a conditional-required ask went 0/2 in the same session (recorded inconsistent, not impossible); visibility and required are sibling concepts everywhere else in this graph.
RHSValue for a Boolean trigger is the STRING "true" — same string-typed wire convention as Expression Static nodes.
